channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemeni forces say they repel Houthi attacks in Taiz as fighting rages
item.description: Government forces say dozens of Houthis killed in southwestern governorate during battles for strategic highlands.

item.title: Afghanistan vows to respond after Pakistani air strikes kill four
item.description: Pakistan said it carried out air strikes on 10 locations in Afghanistan used to store and launch drones.

item.title: Trump-Xi summit: Here’s what’s on the agenda, and why it matters
item.description: The leaders of the US and China are expected to discuss trade, AI and Iran in their third in-person meeting in a year.

item.title: Why have some nations developed while others struggle?
item.description: At UNGA, Iran, Syria and Kenya have highlighted how war and injustice have skewed global development.

item.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
item.description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

item.title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
item.description: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

item.title: In Amish country, nurses go door to door to stop deadly spread of measles
item.description: With four measles-related deaths in Pennsylvania, health officials are hoping to get people on board with vaccines in private.

item.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
item.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.
